protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: miSyncDestroyFence sets beingDestroyed, then invokes CounterDestroyed while walking fence trigger nodes. SyncAwaitTriggerFired can free the shared SyncAwaitUnion; with multiple Await conditions on the same fence, later nodes retain pTrigger pointers into freed memory and the destroy loop dereferences them.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: CONFIRMED: 1c4a0db2c6bf0320cb630b84ab87bcfd3801a53d is the first commit that writes miSyncDestroyFence and its unsafe callback-before-next-pointer loop. Later protocol wiring makes the path client-reachable but does not write the vulnerable loop; later style/guard commits preserve it.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: CONFIRMED: immediate parent af0f9f913398d34a885c3fb4e8d40c1a7e2b3ee9 has only the prior 25-line miext/sync/misync.c stub and no miSyncDestroyFence. The analogous FreeCounter pattern exists in Xext/sync.c, but the vulnerable fence destructor lines do not.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: CONFIRMED: the BIC has exactly one parent, directly adds the function in public history, and is neither a merge nor a later aggregate requiring member decomposition. git log -L traces the loop directly to this object; decomposed_shas correctly remains empty.
protocol_checks.affected_fixed_release_membership: CONFIRMED: the BIC is ancestral to xorg-server-21.1.22 and xwayland-24.1.11, whose tagged source still contains the unsafe loop. xorg-server-21.1.23 contains cherry-pick f304b57444be3991fd9d3389f309c6eeb056a6c4 and xwayland-24.1.12 contains cherry-pick 4b9638714e669af5850ef4d4bfc5bc445c0c5dda; both tagged sources contain the repaired loop. Mainline f5abfb61994471023d8c6470428c8e30c411cc0b is ancestral to the 26.0.99.901 tags.
protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_unpatched: CONFIRMED: f5abfb61994471023d8c6470428c8e30c411cc0b directly changes miSyncDestroyFence to advance pTriglist before callbacks, tolerate nulled triggers, and changes FreeAwait to null shared trigger pointers before freeing the union. Its stable-branch cherry-picks carry the release fix.
protocol_checks.bic_only_ai_attribution: CONFIRMED: the BIC object is authored and committed by James Jones and contains only Signed-off-by and Reviewed-by trailers, with no AI-assistance marker or bot identity. Assisted-by: Claude:claude-opus-4-6 occurs only on the 2026 fix and is excluded from BIC attribution.
protocol_checks.authoritative_advisory: CONFIRMED: the X.Org June 2, 2026 advisory identifies the miSyncDestroyFence UAF, the two-connection Await/DestroyFence mechanism, direct fix f5abfb61994471023d8c6470428c8e30c411cc0b, and fixed releases 21.1.23/24.1.12. CVE-2026-50257 is PUBLISHED and records CWE-416, so this is not a withdrawn or rejected advisory.

findings: Independent clone replay agrees with the primary mechanism, first-write BIC, parent, fix, release boundaries, and NOT_AI classification.
The later client-facing fence creation/destruction and AwaitFence commits complete reachability but do not replace the protocol-defined first-write BIC.
